description: Error Handling and Monitoring - Global ErrorBoundary with user-friendly fallback UI, structured error reporting infrastructure, unhandled promise rejection catching, and network error recovery with retry logic.
steps: Create src/components/layout/ErrorBoundary.jsx - a React class component error boundary with: componentDidCatch logging to the error reporter, user-friendly fallback UI showing 'Something went wrong' with option to reload or go home, different severity levels (recoverable vs fatal), expandable error details in development mode.

Create src/lib/errorReporter.js - structured error reporting module: captureException(error, context) function that logs structured JSON to console (severity, timestamp, component, user action, stack trace), captureMessage(message, level) for non-error events, breadcrumb trail (last 20 user interactions), network error classification (timeout, server error, auth error, connectivity). Structure it so replacing console logging with Sentry/DataDog is a single-line change.

Create src/hooks/useNetworkRetry.js - a hook providing: retryable fetch wrapper with exponential backoff (max 3 retries), configurable retry delays, user feedback via toast notifications on retry/failure, cancel mechanism for unmounted components, online/offline awareness using existing useOnlineStatus hook.
Update src/main.jsx to add global unhandledrejection and error event listeners that route to errorReporter.captureException.
Update src/App.jsx to wrap the BrowserRouter with the ErrorBoundary component.
Create src/components/layout/__tests__/ErrorBoundary.test.jsx testing: renders children normally, shows fallback on error, shows details in dev mode, reload button works.
Create src/lib/__tests__/errorReporter.test.js testing: captureException logs structured data, breadcrumbs are maintained with max size, captureMessage works at different levels.
Create src/hooks/__tests__/useNetworkRetry.test.js testing: successful fetch returns data, retries on failure with backoff, gives up after max retries, cancels on unmount.
acceptance_criteria: ErrorBoundary catches component errors and shows a friendly fallback UI
errorReporter.captureException logs structured error data to console
Unhandled promise rejections are caught globally and reported
useNetworkRetry hook retries failed requests with exponential backoff
verification: Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run` and confirm all tests pass including new ones
